checks.name: Legacy database, signature, profile and template migrate in WebKit
Cold visit stays below 10 MB decoded and excludes OCR/template downloads
Core precache is installed; optional tools are absent from it
Core viewer opens offline and uses 16px inputs / 44px controls
Fill, save, and reopen standard form fields
Both signature slots save, rename, place, replace and delete
Quick check, X and date stamps can be placed, resized, moved and deleted
White-out creates a movable/resizable/deletable visual cover
Text tool supports tap-to-type and accessible text editing
Prepare-then-share uses a ready file and a fresh active user tap
Reorder / rotate / delete pages keeps field values and editable widgets
Lock form fields exports a read-only copy without losing its values
Merging another PDF warns before flattening and exports fixed forms
OCR is loaded on demand, recognizes text, and is cached after use
Template Studio loads only on demand, generates PDF, and its module caches
Landscape layout and input sizes remain usable
Sheets edit, calculate, undo, row editor, save and export Excel
Writer edits, Word export and PDF handoff retain content
Notes and job records save, link, survive navigation and backup
Office inputs and controls fit phone; used workspaces load with origin unavailable
No functional browser errors or external requests

method: PDF regression plus focused Office checks; shared startup scenarios repeated.
limits: Native iOS share sheet was stubbed to verify file readiness and active user gesture; not an actual OS share.
No physical iPhone, notch/home-bar hardware, Apple Files destination, or real finger hardware tested.
